integrity: Formula is proved symbolically by centralizer semisimple quotient, filtration trace and finite-field Gauss sums. Dependency-free finite examples corroborate, but do not substitute for, the all-dimensions proof.
scientific_limitations: Counts trace fibers of the invertible centralizer of an arbitrary finite-field matrix, with no joint trace-and-determinant or conjugacy-fiber census. Literature comparison may miss differently termed prior work; no independent external audit has been performed.
title: Trace fibers of invertible matrix centralizers over every finite field
